item.title: Rainfall Advisory #VISPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
Issued at 12:15 AM 15 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Palawan(Taytay, Roxas, SanVicente and ElNido) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Palawan(Araceli and Dumaran) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
